subject: Post-call: Onboarding milestones & procurement items (Ariba / W-9 / banking)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-call: Onboarding milestones & procurement items (Ariba / W-9 / banking)

Hi Alicia / procurement team —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our discovery call, I put together a short set of milestones for the vendor onboarding path so we have clear responsibilities and a target close date. I attached a one-page MAP draft for your procurement team to review (Redwood_MAP_Orion_Onboarding_20270404.pdf).

High level (draft):
- Milestone 1 — Vendor enrollment in Ariba / Coupa (owner: Orion procurement) — target: 2 weeks
- Milestone 2 — Legal review & PO terms (owner: Orion legal + Redwood sales) — target: 1 week after Ariba enrollment
- Milestone 3 — Tax forms & banking (W-9 + ACH) (owner: Redwood finance + Orion procurement) — target: concurrent with PO
- Milestone 4 — Test invoices & payment verification (owner: Orion AP) — target: within 7 days of first invoice

Open dependencies we identified:
- Ariba/Coupa: what connector flow does Orion require (punchout vs supplier portal)?
- Format for banking details (ACH vs Wire), and whether an AP contact is required in the Ariba vendor record.
- Any additional compliance evidence (if needed we can provide SOC2 report and network diagram).

Requested next steps:
1) Can procurement confirm preferred vendor intake path (Ariba / Coupa / direct PO) and a single point of contact for vendor enrollment?
2) If Ariba/Coupa, please share the vendor setup instructions or a call invite with your supplier enablement contact.
3) I will upload our W-9 and a short vendor packet once you confirm the enrollment path.

Attaching: Redwood_MAP_Orion_Onboarding_20270404.pdf (draft)

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: Post-call: Onboarding milestones & procurement items (Ariba / W-9 / banking)

Laura —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. Quick answers from procurement: we use Ariba (supplier portal) and our supplier enablement team is the owner of the enrollment step. I looped in Carlos (cc) who coordinates supplier uploads.

For us the typical path is: supplier portal enrollment -> W-9 -> vendor bank form (ACH) -> PO issuance. We can usually complete enrollment in ~10 business days if the supplier provides the W-9 and ACH details promptly.

Action items on our side:
- Carlos: will send the supplier portal invite and enrollment checklist tomorrow.
- Procurement: will provision a test PO after enrollment for payment verification.

A couple of clarifying Qs:
- Does Redwood have a vendor ID we should include in Ariba when we do the upload?
- Please confirm the email to send the W-9 and banking forms to (we prefer a secure upload link).

Thanks — looking forward to the MAP becoming actionable.

—Alicia
Alicia Moreno
Sr. Procurement Manager | Orion Health Systems
